20 distinct 0-param JSR targets, every target name EXACTLY 16 characters -- the missing crossed cell for OQ-JSRPARAMCOST. Two findings are each exact on valid data but neither can be wired: distinct-target COUNT gives +125/target (6/6 points, d = 125n - 280) measured at a fixed 16-char name, and target-NAME LENGTH gives +80 per 8 chars (5/5 points) measured at a fixed 10 targets. Those two 1-D slices only intersect at (n=10, len=16), so whether the name cost is PER TARGET or PER FILE is undecidable. Crossing n=20/40 with len=16/32 decides it: per-target means the len32 file gains n x the len16 file's step, per-file means both gain the same fixed amount.
